name: behind-the-headlines-video
description: Hackathon submission video (Remotion) for Behind the Headlines - BU Induction Hack 2026

scripts.render: npm run data && remotion render BehindTheHeadlines out/behind-the-headlines.mp4
scripts.render:draft: npm run data && remotion render BehindTheHeadlines out/draft.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=30
scripts.stills: npm run data && node scripts/stills.mjs BehindTheHeadlines out/stills 660 1740 2066 2780 3230
